notes.title: Mystery Chamber World - Coming to Steam
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41218393/14f9b537c37412195ae6bdfd800fff1327c4ef45.png[/img]
MC 2015 Deluxe is back, but with a new title and upcoming updates! Meet Mystery Chamber World.

The game will be released on Steam along with the long-awaited 1.2 update, and will receive two more updates over time. Add the game to your wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3523170/Mystery_Chamber_World
🔍 You can learn more about the upcoming updates [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rXQY9vxZYUjZz2F2VF_2g3N5hYY3F4ww][b]here[/b][/url]

notes.title: Mystery Chamber 2015 Forever — Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259267/cf66bd942b7c1911547f3e9fdb140927537be3c9.png[/img]
Update 1.2 for MC 2015 Deluxe was something big. Meet [b]Mystery Chamber 2015 Forever[/b]! With innovations and new possibilities for your creativity, the game is coming on PC and Steam!

More details will come later, but for now watch the video, it shows the main game changes.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ULgP9sycEDY

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707590/Mystery_Chamber_2015_Forever/
